title: ptyrelay.py: a chat, an interactive agent kept running with nobody looking
about: Tasks W17 and W90. A Relay runs one agent on a pty (a pseudo-terminal: a fake screen and keyboard a program can hold). The web page types into it with send; the terminal screen can attach to it and detach again. ChatHost keeps one Relay per scope (a task id, or project) and closes the idle ones.
